description: Read one message in full: from, to, cc, reply-to, date, subject, labels, the body as plain text (HTML is converted to text), and the list of attachments with part_id, name, type and size. Use it after search_emails when you need what a single message says; use read_thread instead for the whole conversation. The body is cut at max_chars and marked "[truncated]" with truncated=true; attachment contents are not included (fetch one with get_attachment). An unknown message_id returns an error saying the message was not found. Read-only; does not mark the message as read.

account.description: Which mailbox: email address, alias, or local part. Optional when only one account is connected.

max_chars.description: Longest body to return, in characters (default 20,000). Raise it for long newsletters or legal text.

message_id.description: The message id ("id") returned by search_emails or list_drafts.

name: read_email
title: Read a message
